g.title: milestones
g.text: 32 milestone nodes across preparation, three regional services and the finale
Solid arrows: physical input / output flow. Dashed arrows: optional route or practice progression.
Branches can be reordered. Shutdown may happen early. Labels identify record and cache links.

a.xlink:title: Begin cargo practice
Begin ascent practice
Begin reversal practice
Apply the cargo construction procedure
Apply ascent at the depot
Service kit provides both reserve items
Tooling is at the upper expedition depot
Apply motion reversal
Survey pack enables archive survey
Retrieve the cached lamp kit; caching itself is optional
Retrieve the cached drive coupling; caching itself is optional
Bring original tooling to the workbench; it is consumed
Released original power module
Reach the gallery after the cargo crossing
Deliver the original module to cooling works
Gallery opens the installation shutter
Installed intact cooling equipment plus correct dials
All three equipment outputs trigger bridge closure
Cooling must currently be balanced
Released original anchor coupling
Delivered coupling can be installed
Installed intact anchor equipment plus correct dials
All three equipment outputs trigger bridge closure
Anchors must currently be balanced
Charged cell powers shuttle equipment
Original spindle for monitoring installation
Installed monitoring equipment plus correct dials
All three equipment outputs trigger bridge closure
Monitoring must currently be balanced
Discover the replacement approach
Installed original drive coupling enables the cargo lock
Platform provides access; alternatives are permitted
Reference barge delivery; alternative physical routes are permitted
Original intact relief load currently at commissioned refuge
Fabricated original manifold becomes physical cargo
Intact original manifold currently installed at engine bus
Sustained engine shutdown
B01: Accept the commission. Remember the designated refuge
B02: Commission the training barge. Loaded craft / trim trial
B03: Deliver the practice load. Independent cargo construction
B04: Open the maintenance loft. Learn an ascent route
B05: Recover the depot service kit. Lamp kit + final-lock coupling
B06: Restore the training platform. Learn motion reversal
B07: Retrieve the survey pack. Independent platform route
B08: Survey at the weather archive. Local record: cooling profile
B09: Distribute expedition reserves. Remember the two chosen caches
R01: Recover the original tooling. Upper depot; may cache and retrieve
a.text: Upper depot; may cache and retrieve

a.xlink:title: B12: Establish the deep outpost. Lamp kit from B05 / cache B09
a.text: Lamp kit from B05 / cache B09

a.xlink:title: B13: Ferry the power module. Loaded craft through flooded works
B14: Open the regulator gallery. Reach the upper service controls
B15: Restore cooling equipment. Install module; sustain output 5 s
R02: Balance the cooling flow. Set dials from the B08-area record
a.text: Set dials from the B08-area record

a.xlink:title: B10: Recover the anchor coupling. Original load from abandoned yard
B16: Deliver the anchor coupling. Adapt the craft for reed channels
a.text: Adapt the craft for reed channels

a.xlink:title: B17: Restore anchor equipment. Install coupling; output for 5 s
R03: Tune anchor load distribution. Set dials from the B12-area record
a.text: Set dials from the B12-area record

a.xlink:title: B11: Charge the shuttle power cell. Local record: monitoring profile
B18: Recover the sky spindle. Power the observatory shuttle
B19: Restore monitoring equipment. Upper controls; output for 5 s
R04: Synchronize the monitoring clock. Set dials from the B11-area record
a.text: Set dials from the B11-area record

a.xlink:title: B20: Survey the changed approach. Bridge closes after equipment repair
B21: Recover & fit the drive coupling. Original part from B05 / cache B09
a.text: Original part from B05 / cache B09

a.xlink:title: B22: Reach the lock service terrace. Three balanced services required
B23: Commission the cargo lock & barge. Fit drive; open berth; test loaded craft
a.text: Fit drive; open berth; test loaded craft

a.xlink:title: B24: Deliver the relief shipment. Original load at commissioned refuge
R05: Fabricate the pressure manifold. Tooling + all 3 balanced services
R06: Transport & install the manifold. 280 kg original load to engine bus
a.text: 280 kg original load to engine bus

a.xlink:title: R07: Sustain engine shutdown. 5 s / synchronization, grounding or capacitors
R08: Commission stable refuge power. All 3 services live + relief + manifold. Engine stopped + local switch armed / 30 s
a.text: Engine stopped + local switch armed / 30 s
